title: Binary Output

"Takes in a linear signal, and will output it up to 5 bits of binary."

The Binary Output is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It is used to unpack a binary state from a numeric signal.

Functionality

The Bit Out accepts a decimal signal of up to 32 and converts it into 5 separate outputs. Each output corresponds to a binary digit. For example, sending a signal of 27 to the input would enable the ports from left to right as (1,1,0,1,1). All outputs will have a signal strength of 10 if activated.

Trivia

  • During testing of the Logic system, this was known as the BITOUTComponent.
